description: The line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across model layers, using a threshold of 1e-2 to define sparsity. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with integer tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating discrete transformer layers. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, representing the proportion of attention weights below the threshold. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” starts near 0.25 at layer 0 and declines steadily to near 0.0 by layer 23. An orange dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins near 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to ~0.6 by layer 5, then fluctuates between 0.25 and 0.45 through layer 23. A green dash-dot line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” starts near 1.0, declines steeply to ~0.3 by layer 10, then oscillates mildly between 0.1 and 0.2 until layer 23. A gray square legend marker appears below the main legend but is not associated with any plotted line.
